```{r}
# Distribusi Bernoulli
dbinom(x = 1, size = 1, prob = 0.3)
pbinom(q = 1, size = 1, prob = 0.3)
qbinom(p = 1, size = 1, prob = 0.3)
rbinom(n = 20, size = 1, prob = 0.3)
```

```{r}
# Distribusi Binomial
dbinom(x = 1, size = 5, prob = 0.3)
pbinom(q = 1, size = 5, prob = 0.3)
qbinom(p = 1, size = 5, prob = 0.3)
rbinom(n = 20, size = 5, prob = 0.3)
```

```{r}
# Distribusi Poisson
dpois(x = 3, lambda = 5)
ppois(q = 3, lambda = 5)
qpois(p = 0.3, lambda = 5)
rpois(n = 20, lambda = 5)
```

```{r}
# Distribuai Uniform
dunif(x = 0.5, min = 0, max = 5)
punif(q = 0.5, min = 0, max = 5)
qunif(p = 0.5, min = 0, max = 5)
runif(n = 20, min = 0, max = 5)
```

```{r}
# Distribusi Normal
dnorm(x = 0, mean = 0, sd = 1)
pnorm(q = 1.96, mean = 0, sd = 1)
qnorm(p = 0.95, mean = 65, sd = 8)
rnorm(n = 20, mean = 0, sd = 1)
```

```{r}
# Distribusi Eksponensial
dexp(x = 1, rate = 2)
pexp(q = 1, rate = 2)
qexp(p = 0.25, rate = 2)
rexp(n = 20, rate = 2)
```

```{r}
# Distribusi Gamma
dgamma(x = 1, shape = 3, rate = 5)
pgamma(q = 2, shape = 3, rate = 5)
qgamma(p = 0.8, shape = 3, rate = 5)
rgamma(n = 20, shape = 3, rate = 5)
```

```{r}
# Transformasi Linear
set.seed(566096)
x <- rnorm(n = 1000, mean = 10, sd = 5)
y <- (2*x) + 5
mean(y)
sd(y)
```

```{r}
# Transformasi Non-linear
set.seed(566096)
x <- rnorm(1000, mean = 0, sd = 1)
y <- exp(x)
hist(y, breaks = 30, main = "Distribusi Log-Normal Standar")
```

```{r}
# Tranfromasi Invers Via Uniform
set.seed(566096)
u <- runif(n = 1000)
lambda <- 2
x <- log(1 - u) / - lambda
hist(x, breaks = 30, freq = FALSE, main = "Eksponensial Via Invers")
curve(dexp(x, rate = lambda), add = TRUE, col = "red")
```

```{r}
# Uji Inferensi Mean 1 Populasi
df <- c(32, 33, 30, 33, 35, 36, 34, 34, 37)

library(BSDA)
z.test(df, mu = 35, sigma.x = 5, alternative = "two.sided")

t.test(df, mu = 35, alternative = "two.sided")
```

```{r}
# Uji Inferensi Mean 2 Populasi Independen
dfx <- c(32, 33, 30, 33, 35, 36, 34, 34, 37)
dfy <- c(33, 30, 29, 28, 29, 27, 30, 28, 31)

library(BSDA)
z.test(dfx, dfy, mu = 0, sigma.x = 5, sigma.y = 4, alternative = "two.sided")

var.test(dfx, dfy)
t.test(dfx, dfy, mu = 0, var.equal = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")

t.test(dfx, dfy, mu = 0, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")
```

```{r}
# Uji Inferensi Mean 2 Populasi Dependen
dfx <- c(32, 33, 30, 33, 35, 36, 34, 34, 37)
dfy <- c(33, 30, 29, 28, 29, 27, 30, 28, 31)

t.test(dfx, dfy, mu = 0, paired = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")
```
